content.sentence: My name is Laura and I live in São Paulo.
content.translation: Meu nome é Laura e eu moro em São Paulo.

content.sentence: I usually wake up at 7 o'clock and take a shower.
content.translation: Eu geralmente acordo às 7 horas e tomo um banho.

content.sentence: After breakfast, I go to work by bus.
content.translation: Depois do café da manhã, eu vou ao trabalho de ônibus.

content.sentence: I work as a teacher and I really enjoy my job.
content.translation: Eu trabalho como professora e realmente gosto do meu trabalho.

content.sentence: In the evening, I cook dinner and watch TV with my family.
content.translation: À noite, eu cozinho o jantar e assisto TV com minha família.

content.sentence: I went to bed at 10:30 last night.
content.translation: Eu fui dormir às 22:30 ontem à noite.

comprehension_questions.question: What time does Laura wake up?
comprehension_questions.explanation: The text says 'I usually wake up at 7 o'clock'.

comprehension_questions.question: How does Laura go to work?
Laura watches TV alone in the evening.
comprehension_questions.explanation: 'I watch TV with my family' — she watches with her family.

content.sentence: Last Monday, I had an important job interview at a big company.
content.translation: Na segunda-feira passada, eu tive uma entrevista de emprego importante em uma grande empresa.

content.sentence: I have worked in marketing for three years.
content.translation: Eu tenho trabalhado em marketing por três anos.

content.sentence: The interviewer asked me about my previous experience.
content.translation: O entrevistador me perguntou sobre minha experiência anterior.

content.sentence: I have never missed a deadline in my career.
content.translation: Eu nunca perdi um prazo na minha carreira.

content.sentence: They offered me the position and I accepted it immediately.
content.translation: Eles me ofereceram a vaga e eu a aceitei imediatamente.

comprehension_questions.question: When did the interview happen?
comprehension_questions.explanation: 'Last Monday, I had an important job interview.'

comprehension_questions.question: How long has the person worked in marketing?
comprehension_questions.explanation: 'I have worked in marketing for three years.'

comprehension_questions.question: The person got the job.
comprehension_questions.explanation: 'They offered me the position and I accepted it.'
